tailoring.headline: Senior Fullstack Engineer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Java Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and headless commerce. Proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and agile techno-functional consulting with international stakeholders. I also lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive performance tuning of SQL queries.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d) – E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Instaffo because of its innovative approach to e-commerce platforms and its commitment to delivering seamless digital experiences. With more than five years of hands-on experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, microservices and full-stack integration that aligns perfectly with your Senior Fullstack Engineer role.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), handling product, catalog and pricing data, and at Shell I maintained core Hybris modules such as Promotions Engine and Order Management.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, and integrated SOAP and REST services across ERP, MDM and Profisee systems.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: I created robust PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved complex integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and external platforms.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), leveraged Docker and Kubernetes for cloud deployments, and contributed to agile Scrum teams, driving sprint planning and code reviews.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026 – I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Instaffo.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Fullstack Engineer – E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die innovative Ausrichtung von Instaffo im E-Commerce-Umfeld begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Skalierung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how in Java, Spring, Microservices und Full-Stack-Integration mit, das exakt zu Ihrer Position als Senior Fullstack Engineer passt.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Funktionen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, inkl. Produkt- und Katalog-Management, und bei Shell zentrale Hybris-Module wie Promotions-Engine und Order-Management betreut.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Web-Services und Headless-APIs für Storefronts und Drittanbieter bereitgestellt sowie SOAP- und REST-Schnittstellen zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee integriert.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Ich konzipierte robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub und löste komplexe Integrationsengpässe zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und externen Systemen.

bullets.label: Agile Lieferung & CI/CD
bullets.text: Ich führte CI/CD-Deployments auf der SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) durch, nutzte Docker und Kubernetes für Cloud-Deployments und arbeitete in agilen Scrum-Teams, inklusive Sprint-Planung und Code-Reviews.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026 – ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Instaffo’s reputation for building cutting-edge, data-driven e-commerce platforms aligns with my passion for creating scalable, AI-enhanced digital experiences. I admire your focus on seamless integration of PIM, ERP and headless commerce, and the collaborative, agile culture that empowers engineers to innovate. Contributing my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to such a forward-thinking team would allow me to drive impactful solutions for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and full-stack expertise to help Instaffo deliver innovative, high-performance e-commerce solutions that delight customers and drive growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of Java and full-stack experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Senior Fullstack Engineer role at Instaffo and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Fullstack Engineer – E-Commerce position at Instaffo. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
